key_evidence_spans: A 56-year-old woman with no significant medical history presented with a 4-week history of dry cough and mild weight loss
coarse crepitations were heard over the right upper and lower lung zones
A chest radiograph showed an air-space opacity in the right upper lobe
CT of the thorax demonstrated multifocal consolidations in the right upper lobe extending to the right lower lobe
A Mantoux tuberculin skin test showed 10 mm of induration
Sputum induction for acid-fast bacilli was negative
bronchoalveolar lavage was negative for Xpert Mycobacterium tuberculosis/rifampicin assay as well as bacterial and fungal cultures
